title: RNA seqFISH+ Supplementary Protocol
protocol: Functionalize the coverslips before plating cells or tissue sectioning.
Subject the coverslips to plasma cleaner at HIGH for 5 minutes.
Immerse the coverslips in 1M HCl at room temperature for 1 hour.
Rinse the coverslips with water once after HCl treatment.
Immerse the coverslips in 1M NaOH solution at room temperature for 1 hour.
Prepare a 1% bind-silane solution made in pH 3.5 10% (v/v) acidic ethanol solution.
Immerse the clean coverslips in the bind-silane solution for 30 minutes to 1 hour at room temperature.
Rinse the coverslips with ethanol three times after bind-silane treatment.
Heat-cure the silanized coverslips in an oven > 90°C for 30 minutes.
Treat the coverslips with 100 μg/μL of Poly-D-lysine in water for >1 hour at room temperature.
Alternatively, treat the coverslips with 50 μg/μL of Poly-D-lysine in 1x PBS for >1 hour at room temperature.
Rinse the coverslips three times with water after polylysine treatment.
Air-dry the coverslips in the hood.
UV-sanitize the coverslips.
Seed 100,000 - 120,000 NIH/3T3 cells in 1 mL of media on a coverslip for a 24 x 50 mm coverslip size.
Place the seeded coverslips in a petri dish to prevent drying out of the media.
Allow the cells to adhere to the coverslips for 1 hour at 37°C.
Replenish with 5 mL of media and allow the cells to grow to 80-90% confluency.
Prepare a fresh 4% formaldehyde buffer in 1x PBS.
Rinse the cells with 5 mL of 1x PBS and remove the PBS.
Fix the cells with 4% formaldehyde buffer for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the formaldehyde buffer and wash the fixed cells with 1x PBS.
Permeabilize the fixed cells with 70% ethanol for 1 hour at room temperature.
Store permeabilized fixed cells at 4°C or -20°C in 70% ethanol depending on storage time.
Air-dry the permeabilized fixed cells completely before primary probe hybridization at room temperature.
Cryo-section the tissue block in OCT with 5-20 μm thickness and immediately place on functionalized coverslips.
Store the tissue slices at -80°C until permeabilization.
Permeabilize tissue slices at 4°C for more than one hour by placing coverslips in a tube with 70% ethanol.
Dry the coverslip and clear the tissue slices with 1 mL of 8% SDS in 1x PBS at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Rinse the tissue slices with 1 mL of 1x PBS.
Rinse the tissue slices with multiple times with 1 mL of 70% ethanol solution.
Allow the tissue slice to dry before hybridizing the primary probes.
Hybridize primary probes using a concentration of 1 nM per probe in 40% formamide, 2x SSC, and 10% Dextran Sulfate (500,000 molecular weight).
Use either Acrydite/polyT15 LNA probe or Acrydite/polyT30 LNA probe at a concentration of 2 μM for primary probes hybridization.
Hybridize the tissue slices with primary probes for 36 to 48 hours, typically finding that 48 hours yields slightly brighter signals.
Drop 5-20 μL of primary probes hybridization solution on the cells or tissue slices.
Cover the drops of primary probes hybridization solution with another coverlip.
Place the sample in a humidified chamber and incubate at 37°C for designated time.
Remove the sample from the incubator after the hybridization time.
If it is difficult to remove coverslips, place 1 mL of 40% wash buffer covering the entire coverslip and samples for 15 minutes or more.
Gently move away the coverslip on top of the sample using a tweezer.
Place fresh 1 mL 40% wash buffer on the sample and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Wash the sample to remove non-specific binding and ensure low background.
Remove the sample from the 37°C incubator and discard the wash buffer.
Rinse the sample multiple times with 2x SSC and keep in 2x SSC before proceeding.
Prepare 4% acrylamide solution in 2x SSC using a pre-mixed acrylamide/bis solution.
Degas the acrylamide solution on ice for 15 minutes with nitrogen gas bubbling.
Prepare fresh 20% w/v ammonium persulfate and 20% v/v TEMED solutions in RNase-free water, keep them on ice.
Functionalize a microscope slide with 1 ml of GelSlick solution at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the GelSlick solution and ensure the microscope slide is dry.
Remove the 2x SSC from the sample and replace it with Tetraspeck beads solution (1:1000 dilution in 2x SSC) at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Aspirate the bead solution and rinse the sample multiple times with 2x SSC.
Drop 500 μL of the 4% acrylamide solution onto the sample.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate all of the 4% acrylamide solution carefully.
Prepare 4% hydrogel solution by mixing 4% acrylamide solution with 0.2% APS and 0.2% TEMED.
Drop 10 μL of 4% hydrogel solution onto the sample.
Gently sandwich the droplet using a GelSlick functionalized microscope slide across the coverslip to form a cross.
Ensure no bubbles are formed between the coverslips.
Transfer the sample into a humidified nitrogen gas chamber.
Degas the nitrogen gas chamber for 10 minutes by punching holes on opposite sides of the lid and ensuring air flow.
Slowly turn off the flow of nitrogen gas while sealing the holes with duct tape.
Allow the polymerization to happen at room temperature for at least 1 hour.
Remove the 2x SSC on the sample and wash with 1x PBS once.
Prepare a 0.1 mg/mL Acryoloyl-X SE solution in 1x PBS.
Remove the 1x PBS from the tissue and cover it entirely with 200 μL of AcX solution for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the AcX solution and rinse with 2x SSC once.
Pre-incubate the tissue with 500 μL of 4% acrylamide solution at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Prepare a 4% tissue hydrogel solution by mixing the 4% acrylamide solution with 0.05% APS and 0.05% TEMED.
Aspirate all the 4% acrylamide solution.
Drop 20 μL of the 4% tissue hydrogel solution onto the tissue slice.
Sandwich the droplet gently by placing a GelSlick functionalized microscope slide across the sample, avoiding the formation of bubbles.
Transfer the sample into a humidified nitrogen gas chamber.
Degas the nitrogen gas chamber for 10 minutes by punching holes through the Tupperware lids on opposite sides.
Ensure air flow from one hole to the other side of the lid during degassing.
Slowly turn off the flow of nitrogen gas while sealing the holes with duct tape.
Transfer the sample in the humidified nitrogen gas chamber to 4°C for 30 minutes before transferring to 37°C for 2.5 hours to complete the polymerization.
Prepare 1 mL of digestion/clearing buffer containing 1:100 Proteinase K, 50 mM pH8 Tris HCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5% Triton-X 100, 500 mM NaCl, and 1% SDS.
Incubate the sample in digestion/clearing buffer for 1 hour at 37°C in a humidified chamber for seqFISH+ cell culture experiments.
Incubate the sample in digestion/clearing buffer for 3 hours at 37°C in a humidified chamber for seqFISH+ tissue experiments.
Wash the sample multiple times with 2x SSC solution after clearing, allowing up to 30 minutes per wash.
Perform Label-IT modification (1:10) in the manufacturer’s provided buffer on cell culture samples at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Post-fix the sample with 4% formaldehyde solution in 1x PBS to crosslink DNA, RNA, and overall cell structure for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Quench the reaction with 1M pH 8.0 Tris HCl for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Keep the sample in 4x SSC supplemented with 2U/μL of SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor at 4°C for no longer than 6 hours.
Mix equal amounts of Acryoyl-X SE and Label-IT in DMSO and allow the reaction to happen overnight on a shaker.
Pre-incubate the tissue slice with 50-100 μL of Label-IT buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Treat the cleared tissue slice with 50μL of 1:10 dilution of Label-X in Label-IT buffer provided by the manufacturer.
Transfer to a humidified chamber and cover the droplets of solution with a coverslip.
Allow the modification to happen for 45 minutes at 37°C.
Prepare a fresh 4% acrylamide solution as described in the Hydrogel for tissue slices section.
Rinse the sample with 2x SSC.
Pre-incubate the sample in 500 μL of 4% acrylamide solution at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Mix the 4% acrylamide solution with 0.05% APS and 0.05% TEMED to prepare a 4% tissue hydrogel solution.
Aspirate all the 4% acrylamide solution from the sample.
Drop 20 μL of the 4% tissue hydrogel solution onto the tissue slice.
Gently sandwich the droplet by placing a GelSlick functionalized microscope slide across the sample to form a cross, avoiding bubble formation.
Transfer the sample into a humidified nitrogen gas chamber.
Degas the nitrogen gas chamber for 10 minutes by punching holes through the Tupperware lids on opposite sides.
Seal the holes with duct tape while slowly turning off the flow of nitrogen gas.
Transfer the sample in the humidified nitrogen gas chamber to 4°C for 30 minutes.
Transfer the sample from 4°C to 37°C for 2 hours to complete the polymerization.
Peel off the microscope slides gently after gelation is complete.
Keep the sample with 4x SSC supplemented with 2U/μL of SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor at 4°C for no longer than 6 hours.
Re-embed the cell culture samples in the 4% tissue hydrogel solution for stabilization.
Prepare 10% ethylene carbonate readout hybridization buffer as per previous protocol.
Put ethylene carbonate solids in a 50mL Falcon tube and melt at a 37°C water bath.
Check the volume of melted ethylene carbonate solution and add equal amount of RNase free water to generate a 50% ethylene carbonate solution.
Aliquot the solution and store it at -20°C.
Mix 10% ethylene carbonate with 10% low molecular weight Dextran Sulfate and 4x SSC to prepare a higher concentration hybridization buffer.
Hybridize readout probes at a concentration of 50nM to 100nM in the prepared hyb buffer for 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate samples with high formamide stripping buffer containing 55% formamide, 2x SSC, and 0.1% Triton X-100 for 1 minute after hybridization.
Rinse the sample with 4x SSC following the incubation step.
Prepare the chamber to receive 1mL of high formamide stripping buffer.
Incubate the chamber with stripping buffer for 1 to 2 minutes to ensure complete removal of readout probes.
Use a Leica microscope equipped with a confocal scanner unit, sCMOS camera, 63x oil objective lens, and motorized stage for imaging.
Scrape off excess gel on the sample and place the flow cell covering the cells or tissue slice.
Prepare fresh buffers including:
Mix 10% formamide, 2x SSC, and 0.1% Triton X-100 to create a 10% wash buffer.
Mix 55% formamide, 2x SSC, and 0.1% Triton X-100 to create a 55% stripping buffer.
Dilute SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor at a ratio of 1:1000 in 4x SSC for the preparation of buffers.
Prepare a DAPI solution at a concentration of 10 μg/mL in 4x SSC.

Mix 10% EC hyb buffer, 10% low molecular weight dextran sulfate, 4x SSC, 50nM Alexa Fluor 647-15nt-readout, 50nM Cy3B-15-nt-readout, 100nM Alexa Fluor 488-15nt-readout, and 1:100 dilution of SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor for readout solutions.

Mix 10% (w/v) glucose, 1:100 diluted catalase (Sigma C3155), 0.5 mg/mL Glucose oxidase (Sigma G2133), and 0.02 U/μL SUPERase In RNase Inhibitor in 4x SSC and 50 mM pH8 Tris HCl to create anti-bleaching buffer.
Take blank images containing beads only before the first round of serial hybridization.
Flow readout probes for the first serial hybridization into the flow cells.
Incubate the probes for 15-20 minutes for hybridization.
Flow ~300 μL of 10% wash buffer through the flow cell.
Follow with 4x SSC, DAPI solution, and anti-bleaching buffer.
Turn on auto-focus to image the sample in fluorescent channels: 647 nm, 561 nm, 488 nm, and 405 nm sequentially.
Take multiple z-sections per field of view (FOV).
Turn off autofocus during z-scanning and turn back on before moving to the next FOV position.
Flow 1 mL of 55% readout stripping buffer through the flow cell and incubate for 1 minute.
If residual signals remain, flow more stripping buffer through the sample and extend incubation time.
Afterward, flow 500 μL of 4x SSC solution through the flow cell to prepare for the next serial hybridization.
Repeat steps 6-10 until 81 rounds of serial hybridizations are completed.
Repeat the first round of hybridization as the last round.
Incubate segmentation staining buffer containing 50nM LNA T-20-Alexa Fluor 647, 1:100 dilution of Nissl stainings, and 10 μg/mL of DAPI in 1x PBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Image the sample after incubation.
